review_summary: As seen and loved on TikTok: THE most comfortable walking shoes for travel. And everything else. ICONIC COMFORT: Anti-odor Insole Technology with anatomical cushioning, comfort, & arch support that uses 15% cushy plant-based BLOOM® foam. FIT: Lace-up front with padded heel for a secure fit. STYLE: Women's lace up low top sneaker featuring a retro-inspired toe cap, minimalist lines, and a sporty 2 inch sole. MATERIALS: Faux leather, organic cotton, fabric, or microfiber partially made from recycled materials. SUSTAINABLY CRAFTED: Fabric lining partially made from recycled materials and partially recycled toe box and heel counter. MOVEMENT: Lightweight, flexible construction moves with you. EASY CLEAN: Styles with light-colored outsoles are pre-treated with Easy Clean Repellant, a topical spray applied to the sidewall of the shoe only, to keep the sides of the shoe’s sole cleaner longer. Care instructions: use water only on a household cloth to wipe sidewall of shoe. Individual results may vary. CONSCIOUSLY PACKAGED: This style is shipped in an environmentally preferred 1-piece box made with primarily recycled materials that can be recycled & soy-based inks. Step up your sneaker rotation with this low top sneaker. The trending pick for a comfortable walking shoe that’s as lightweight as it is iconic.
